forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Circular dependencies make modules impossible to reason about or test in isolation.

forbidden.name: no-deprecated-core
forbidden.comment: Deprecated Node core modules will be removed in a future runtime.

forbidden.name: not-to-dev-dep
forbidden.comment: Shipped code must not import a devDependency — it will be absent from the bundle the installer carries.

forbidden.name: no-non-package-json
forbidden.comment: Dependency used but not declared in package.json — breaks on a clean install.

forbidden.name: renderer-not-into-engine
forbidden.comment: CLAUDE.md section 2: the renderer never reaches the engine directly. It calls Tauri commands and consumes Tauri events, both typed by packages/types, which is generated from the Rust definitions. A renderer file importing from crates/ or src-tauri/ either will not build or is a second, hand-maintained copy of the IPC contract — and a drifting IPC contract is the bug class packages/types exists to design out.

forbidden.name: ui-package-stays-shared
forbidden.comment: packages/* are leaf libraries. A design system that reaches back into an application is not a design system — it is that application with extra steps, and it cannot be used anywhere else. Named for packages/ui, which CLAUDE.md section 4 calls out by name; scoped to every shared package because the reasoning does not stop at ui.

forbidden.name: engine-contract-is-generated
forbidden.comment: packages/types is generated from the Rust types by `pnpm types:generate`. Nothing in it may import application or design-system code: the contract has to be readable by anything that speaks to the engine, and an import out of it inverts that.
